We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon (~10-30 ppm). We need to minimize experiments. Probably just get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals. But overlapping may be ambiguous. Could also get carbon NMR to count methyl carbons. That may be more straightforward: each methyl carbon appears around 10-30 ppm. So count number of peaks in that region.

We can call carbon_nmr_spectra.
